detected_by: operator click on Install: 'invalid args args for command perform_install: command perform_install missing required key args'
impact: Operator could not install updates from the desktop app since 9fb8eaf4e9 (2026-10-07); frontend tests stub invoke and Rust tests call perform_install_impl, so nothing crossed the real IPC boundary
resolution: perform_install now takes manifest + index_url directly; test pins the shim fn signature and drives the flat frontend payload (real Tauri IPC binding still untested)
summary: Desktop Install button failed: perform_install took one struct param (args) so Tauri demanded {args:{...}} while both frontend call sites sent flat {manifest, indexUrl}
